pos.customerSearchLabel: Search customers by name or phone

pos.invalidCash: Enter a non-negative cash amount with no more than two decimal places.

payment.title: Payment
payment.statusChip: Validation preview — this sale has not been saved
payment.noMethodsDescription: No enabled payment methods are configured for this company.
payment.refreshRequired: The catalog changed. Refresh workstation data before continuing.
payment.contextChanged: Something changed while validating. Review the payment and try again.
payment.previewUnavailable: The payment preview is unavailable. Try again.
payment.ineligibleLoyalty: Loyalty tender is not supported yet.
payment.ineligibleBankTransfer: Bank transfer is not supported at checkout.
payment.ineligibleWallet: Wallet tender is not supported at checkout.
payment.ineligibleUnsupported: This payment type cannot be used at checkout.

shiftUnavailable.none: No shift is open. Open a shift before taking payment.
shiftUnavailable.paused: The shift is paused. Resume it before taking payment.
shiftUnavailable.closed: The shift is closed. Open a new shift before taking payment.
shiftUnavailable.cancelled: The shift was cancelled. Open a new shift before taking payment.
shiftUnavailable.reconciliation-required: Shift status needs reconciliation before payment can proceed.
shiftUnavailable.unknown: Shift status is unknown. Refresh before taking payment.
shiftUnavailable.foreign: This shift no longer matches the current session. Refresh before taking payment.

errors.MONEY_INPUT_OUT_OF_RANGE: This amount is outside the allowed range.

completion.abandonWarning: Abandoning does not mean cash was returned or a card charge was voided. Verify the till independently before confirming.
completion.blocked: You have an unresolved sale on this till. Retry it or abandon it before starting a new one. A failed or abandoned sale does not mean cash was returned — verify the till independently.
completion.committed: Sale complete. Offline receipt number {offlineNumber}. This number is local and not a fiscal receipt until synced.
completion.unavailable: The sale could not be completed. Try again.
completion.genericFailure: The sale could not be completed. Review the payment and try again.

rejected.invalid-request: This sale could not be validated. Review the cart and payment, then try again under a new attempt.
rejected.stock-allocation-unavailable: One or more tracked products do not have enough stock allocated to this workstation. Adjust the quantity, or refresh workstation data after an allocation is issued. Refreshing does not create or top up an allocation.
rejected.invariant: An unexpected error stopped this sale. Nothing was charged or saved. Try again.

failed.permission-denied: This workstation session cannot take payment right now.
failed.shift-unavailable: The shift is no longer open. Open a shift before completing this sale.
failed.shift-not-open: The shift is paused, closed, or cancelled. Resume or open a shift before completing this sale.
failed.shift-none: No current shift was found for this workstation. Open a shift before completing this sale.
failed.shift-reconciliation-required: The shift changed and must be refreshed before completing this sale.
failed.shift-observation-foreign: Your session or workstation changed. Refresh workstation data before completing this sale.
failed.shift-observation-unknown: The shift status has not been confirmed. Refresh workstation data before completing this sale.
failed.workstation-unassigned: This workstation has no branch or warehouse assignment. Assign it and refresh workstation data before completing this sale.
failed.allocation-data-unavailable: Tracked stock allocation data is unavailable. Update the backend and refresh workstation data before completing this sale.
failed.allocation-acquisition-unresolved: This sale could not confirm its stock allocation with the server. Nothing was charged or saved. Retry this same sale — retrying is safe and cannot allocate stock twice — or abandon it and verify the till.
failed.context-changed: The shift or workstation assignment changed. Refresh before completing this sale.
failed.refresh-required: The catalog changed. Refresh workstation data — this sale is never repriced automatically.
failed.attempt-conflict: The cart changed since this sale was started. Review it and try again.
failed.attempt-key-unavailable: This attempt could not be started. Try again.
failed.not-found: This sale attempt is no longer available.
failed.attempt-unresolved: This sale is still being resolved.
failed.integrity-inconsistency: This sale's recorded state could not be verified. Contact support before retrying.
failed.policy-blocked: This action is not currently authorized on this device or session.

errors.PAYMENT_INSUFFICIENT_TENDER: The tendered amount does not cover the total.

errors.PAYMENT_TOTAL_LIMIT: The total tendered exceeds the published monetary limit.

catalogRefresh.revisionChanged: The refreshed catalog changed. Rebuild or clear the current cart before selling — prices are never updated on an open cart automatically.
